text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Pager — high CPU on preproc tokenizer service (token-preproc-svc). CPU OOMs causing pods to be killed across us-west1. 7 pods crashed in last 5m. Severity: P1. Paging @sre-eli @eng-oncall.

sre-eli: ack — I'm on it, grabbing logs and starting triage. assigning pager.

eng-oncall: joining. seeing repeated `Killed process` messages and kernel OOMs. pods show `OOMKilled` events and `SIGKILL` in container logs.

ml-ana: any correlation with the long-context batch that started ~09:58? we saw some 10k+ token requests from a partner integration.

support-lee: customers are reporting errors for document-summarize feature around 10:04 UTC. initial estimate: ~18% of requests in us-west failing with 5xx. CS ticket #3421 opened.

eng-oncall: quick sample from pod: ```kubectl logs token-preproc-7b4 -n prod --since=5m
[info] processing prompt id=abc123 cpu=98% ... OOMKilled
kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 1234 (python) score 1000 or sacrifice child
```

eng-oncall: pprof samples look like hot loop in `bytepair_decode` and heavy allocations in `tokenizer.py:decode`. CPU flatlines at 95-100% before kill.

ml-ana: that points to decoding path — we recently rolled tokenizer v1.4.2. Can we repro locally with the long prompt? I'll run a batch against staging.

platform-zoe: node telemetry: gke-node-12 showing frequent pod evictions and kernel OOMs. Also seeing increased system_cpu (user) across nodes. dmesg includes `Out of memory` lines but no GPU Xid here — GPU errors not primary.

platform-zoe: mitigation plan step 1: reduce concurrency and scale down workers per pod. I'll patch the deployment to lower `CONCURRENCY=8` and set replicas to 2 temporarily: `kubectl patch deploy token-preproc -n prod -p '{"spec":{"replicas":2}}'`. Applying now. (reacted :thumbsup: by @eng-oncall)

eng-oncall: doing rolling restart to clear stuck memory: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/token-preproc -n prod` — doing 30s stagger.

ml-ana: additionally enabling KV prefix cache to avoid recomputing tokenization for repeated prefixes. toggling feature flag in configstore: `feature.token_cache=true`. This should cut CPU per-request for known prefixes.

eng-oncall: implemented ingress rule to route heavy contexts to `token-preproc-light` (8k token cap) and return 429 for >12k for now. Updated routing config and tested on canary.

product-jamie: good — can we surface a graceful degradation message to customers instead of opaque 5xxs? support-lee can push a short note to affected users.

support-lee: sending templated email now and updating CS ticket with mitigation steps and ETA.

sre-eli: setting alert snooze for 15m while the mitigations settle to avoid noise. collecting heap/pprof profiles and container memory dumps; saving to s3://redwood-incident-archives/1953456789/.

eng-oncall: discovered one manifest with tokenizer:1.4.2 and `MAX_CHUNK=0` which causes pathological path on certain inputs. Creating rollback PR to pin tokenizer to 1.4.1 and add safety guard. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/tokenizer/pull/789 (in review).

platform-zoe: after scaling/concurrency bump and cache enablement we see CPU drop to 35-60% on affected nodes and no new OOMKills in the last 6m. Pod restarts down from 7 to 0. will keep monitoring.

eng-oncall: prepping handoff notes for night oncall @sre-maya — summary below.

eng-oncall: HANDOFF: suspected cause — tokenization hot loop triggered by tokenizer v1.4.2 on very large prompt batches; leading to sustained CPU and kernel OOMs and eventual pod eviction. Mitigations applied: lowered per-pod concurrency, rolled pods, enabled KV prefix cache, routed >12k prompts to degraded path, canary/rollback PR opened to pin tokenizer to 1.4.1, applied alert snooze, collected profiles. Next actions for oncall: monitor `oom_kill` events, confirm PR rollbacks after review, run load test for long prompts. Estimated customer impact: 18% request failure in us-west for 12m window.

sre-maya: acknowledged, I'll take over in 40m. will watch memory/pprof and confirm rollback tomorrow morning.

incidents-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1953456789. Owner: @sre-eli. Tags: ["tokenizer","cpu-oom","pod-kill","customer-impact"]. Postmortem assigned.

sre-eli: following up — great triage. keep CS updated and add causal footnote to the incident doc once PR merges. (reacted :eyes: by @product-jamie)
